title: Explore one non-record benchmark direction for parameter-golf

operationalConstraints: Resolve runnable candidate identity only from the authoritative task store binding from TASK_STORE_DIR.
Append one exploratory evidence record and regenerate generated campaign views from authoritative measurement evidence.
Keep this direction in non-record exploration mode and prevent benchmark-readiness promotion.

boundaries: Task store candidate selection is the boundary of truth for FAST-30 candidate identity and execution order.
Benchmark adapter execution writes to measurement evidence and generated campaign views only.
Readiness signaling stays outside this slice so exploration output cannot cross into benchmark readiness state.
interfaces: Input: task-store task payload with lane=non-record-exploration, directionTag, candidateId, runConfig, and budgetCaps.
Input/Output: measurement evidence projection interface that appends exploratory evidence and re-renders status/state views.
Output: execution outcome envelope including taskId, candidateId, lane, reasonCode, and completedAt.
risks: If lane or direction validation is weak, non-record candidates may execute on the wrong campaign lane.
If evidence append and view projection diverge, operators can observe stale or conflicting exploration status.
If readiness flags are propagated from exploratory runs, the system can over-claim benchmark readiness.
implementationReadyDecisions: Direction stays pinned to non-record-new-direction for FAST-30.
Budget cap remains maxExperimentsPerDirection=1 for this controlled novelty slice.
Outputs are evidentiary only and explicitly forbid benchmark-readiness claims.
